chapters: Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr koi'm gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Amalekitas juruuñ gook gu tanoolh gu Siklag.

Jano' ba' vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam suudai' u'va maa'n yooxi' gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jajannulhi'ñ gu oidha' bhaan mo'o; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii o'lhia'n gu oidha' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam yooxi' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gio mui'x gu ja'tkam ia'rɨ koko'kam; gio ba' gio gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar jix koko'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ñɨidhat gu Sauul jix koi gu Jonataan gu mar.

Jano' ba' biapma' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk gu Gilboa gu ñi'ook gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan u'u kavɨk aajidha' bhaan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix ñi' jup tɨɨt; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' chɨkka jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Soy gu Amalekita.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' tu' soi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu'.

Na gu' tu' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na gu' bhai'x cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga duaka' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kuruun ga'ra' mo'o guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' jix duu gu chichio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jonataan gu mar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Israeel; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr biapma' ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' duukat jix duu tu' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu mar ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Amalekita.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam choo'n jix duu gu novɨ na ba' kooda' Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Dabii maa'n biipibop; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr naaka'n jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr ka't bhaan mo'o gu chin guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu Yo guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii gu Sauul gu Jonataan gu mar bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' gio guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam u'u gat gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ua'nak u'uan jix duu; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Israeel bhaan gɨ' kavɨk gu Koomo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Gat cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Askaloon; na gu' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Pilisteos na gu' cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu kakkavɨk gu Gilboa tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' dhuuk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'nkar na jix maa; na gu' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kutun kavɨk jix kavɨk kutun kavɨk gu Sauul na ja'p tu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ Xoi'kam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Jano' ba' cham gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix kavɨk u'u gat gu Jonataan cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' gu kuchii gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Sauul gu Jonataan tɨɨdam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' koi'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jonataan jix koi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ no'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' xibhɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jonataan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix gɨ' bhai' ka't xoi'kam gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu jiim; jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' duukat guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx gook gu u'vɨ gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita gu Abigail ka't gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gio gu Dabii baidhak gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' maa'n bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jɨ'dɨlh gu ebroon.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu chio'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr gu Jabes gu Galaad guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii jix duu gu Jabes gu Galaad tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Sauul tu jiim jix maa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r; gio ba' tu' gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' gu noobh tu jiim jix kavɨk; na gu' jix koi gu Sauul gu Jawatan gu vaak gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ Xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Sauul jix bhɨɨ gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Galaad bhaan gu Gessuri bhaan gu Jesreel bhaan gu Epraim bhaan gu Benjamiin bhaan bɨx gu Israeel.

Na pai' dhuuk oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vaak gu Judaa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh gu Dabii jix gɨ'kora' gu ebroon bhaan gu vaak gu Judaa kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner jix buus gu Maanaim gu Gabaoon bɨɨx tu duukam gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia tu duukam gu Dabii moor guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Gabaoon; gio ba' na ja'p jum daa'ñ tu jiim baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Joab; gio ba' gu Lebaantense jano' biipibop guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ vupui bhaan no'ch; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Lebaantense.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup jɨɨ'ñdhidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Benjamiin baasɨ'n gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' maa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ mo'o duiñchu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kuchii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano'maram guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu elkat-assurim gu Gabaoon.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abner gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu duukam gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' mi'p vaik gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia; gio ba' gu Joab gu Abisai gu Asael; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Asael ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨt na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu Asael chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abner jiimchu' bhaan cham tu jiim kɨɨ'n tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' cham jix duu tu' gu Asael jix aa'; mi' dhɨr.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abner; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu o'nsop guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga oi'ñdha' biipibop guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gu' gu Asael cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu Abner guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asael; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu vupui xibhɨk gu Joab.

Jano' ba' cham jix duu naaka'n gu Abner bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jix buus u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' bɨx aajidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr pai' gu Asael ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ka't jix koi tu jiim.

Gu' gu' gu Joab gu Abisai bhiadat gu Abner; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tas na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Amma vupui bhaan gu Giia ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu Gabaoon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu Abner tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Abner jix maa jiiñak gu Joab bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham ñɨidhat tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham jix duu tu ñi'ook tu' dɨr dhi' gu xibh gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tɨtda:―Cha'pim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Joab guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham chɨ'ɨɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu Abner guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaak ja'tkam bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' bhɨi gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Bitroon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Maanaim.

Jano' ba' gu Joab gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Abner guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chichio'ñ gu Asael.

Gu' gu' tu duukam gu Dabii jix duu gu Benjamiin gu Abner vaik guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu chichio'ñ jix koko'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Asael guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tukga'n gu taat gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' gu Joab guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ebroon.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu vaak gu Dabii; gu' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ma'nkam gu Dabii gu ebroon; gio ba' maa'nkam mar ka't gu Ammoon gu Ainoam gu Jesreelita.
Jano' ba' gook gu Kileab gu Abigail gu u'vɨ gu Nabal gu Karmelo; gio ba' vaik gu Absaloom gu mar gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Talmai gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu Adoniias gu mar gu aggit; gio ba' jixchamaam gu Sapatiias gu mar gu Abital.
Jano' ba' xijumai gu Jetream gu Egla gu u'vɨ gu Dabii; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Sauul gu Dabii ka't gu Abner guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Sauul guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja; gio ba' jix aa' gu Is-boset gu Abner; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kia'mi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' bhaam gu Abner guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook gu Is-boset; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' mo'o guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu Judaa tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu vaak gu Sauul gu taat bɨɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu' dhagia' gu noobh gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ uañi'ñ dhi' gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Abner guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ atooxkor gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba.
Na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Abner na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Abner jix duu gu Dabii baasɨ'n bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu vupui ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ ka't bɨndak na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' bɨx gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan; na pai' dhuuk gu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham maa'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul na pai' dhuuk jix duu guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' bhañ gu Dabii jix duu gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ gu Mikâl tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Is-boset bhañ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu chio'ñ gu Paltiel gu mar gu Lais.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ ka't bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ joi'ndam bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' jix aa' gu Abner; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abner bɨɨx daraa gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook va'k guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii jum duu gu gɨ'kora' bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu novɨ gu Pilisteos gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gio gu Abner gu Benjamiin; gio ba' ka't gio gu Abner gu ebroon guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Israeel bɨx gu vaak gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Abner gu Dabii gu ebroon bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' gu Dabii jix duu guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Abner bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap.

Ba' jix aa' gu Abner gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu Israeel na ba' xoi'kam bɨndak ñi'ook na jix bhaan tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Dabii guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Abner ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Dabii gu Joab aajidha' yooxi' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ baidhak guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' gu Abner cham ka't bɨɨx gu Dabii gu ebroon tu' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Joab bham; gio ba' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Miren dua'ñ tɨbiap gu Abner tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ka't.

Jano' ba' ñɨidhat tu' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner tu' tɨbiap na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ maachim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab bɨɨx gu Dabii bhañ jix duu bhaan gu Abner suulh dɨr oidha' suudai' gu Sira cham maachim gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Abner guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ebroon jix ai'chdhix gu Joab tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios naaka'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kuiñcha koi'm gu Asael xibhɨk jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mi' dhɨr dhi'; gio ba' na jix bhai' dhi' tu' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ɨ'ɨr gu Abner gu mar gu Ner.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan mo'o gu Joab bhaan bɨx gu vaak gu taat; na cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Joab guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga ɨ'ra'n tu' gakiidha' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu takarui'.
Na gu' gu Joab gu Abisai xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Abner na gu' ka't jix koi gu Asael xibhɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Gabaoon.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Joab bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan gu Abner; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Abner gu ebroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu Abner; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gio bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner chɨtda; gio ba' jix koi gu Abner na ja'p nu'aidha' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu noobh cham mi'p gu ñi'ook tu' tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan tomaat gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix xuaak bhaan.

Jano' ba' na ja'p bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jugi gu takarui' gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tanoolh gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' va'k guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu tas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' gu takarui' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui; na gu' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam xoi'kam gu vupui bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu Israeel aagɨt mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh cham ka't tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' gu Abner gu mar gu Ner vaak jodai.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Israeel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix gɨ'.

Na tu' jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' Xoi'kam; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham bhai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Jano' ba' jix kai gu mar gu Sauul gu Abner ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix koi gu ebroon gu noobh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu mar gu Sauul gook gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa chu'p gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n ka't gu Baana gu Rekâb gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin; na gu' gu Beerot ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu Beerotitas guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Gittaim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm jano' ba'; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul ga'ra' gu mar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨɨt guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn jixchamaam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios koi'm gu Sauul gu Jonataan suudai' u'va gu Jesreel jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ka't gu Mepi-boset.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita gu Rekâb gu Baana jix bɨɨx duu baap jix gɨ' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Is-boset ka't kookos guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' baap tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix duu kai'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Rekâb gu Baana xibhɨk.

Na gu' na ja'p baap gu vaak kua' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam koox jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mo'o guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx gu tukaa' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' aichdhak mo'o gu Is-boset gu Dabii gu ebroon gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o gu Is-boset gu mar gu Sauul bhaamki'ñdha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn kooda'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Sauul gu kai'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Rekâb xibhɨk gu Baana gu ma'nkam gu Rimmoon gu Beerotita; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk maa'n jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bham gu Miren gu Sauul jix koi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Siklag guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tomaat gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu chio'ñ jir bhai' gu vaak bhaan guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jano' cham no'ñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ɨ'ɨr gu noobh jix duu gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa'ñdhix biipibop guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu noobh tɨɨt guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ebroon; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam mo'o gu Is-boset guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tukga'n gu Abner gu ebroon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu Dabii gu ebroon tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm no'ch gu'ch o'oo gu chuukug.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook va'k na pai' dhuuk gu Sauul guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch tu' jix buusñi guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' ka' bhaan gu Israeel gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu ebroon gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ebroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Dabii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na pai' dhuuk kua'da' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix gɨ'kora' oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ebroon jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Judaa kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn masaa'n; gio ba' gu Jerusalem jix gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan bɨx gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jix bɨɨx duu gu Jerusalem gu Jebuseo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Dabii bham; mi' dhɨr tu' cham ba'k guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' cham tu jiim ñiññia mama'mkulhi'; jano' ba' bham; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Sioon kiicham gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix duu gu Jebuseo mama'mkulhi' ñiññia gu i'ii'ñ gu Dabii bhaamki'ñ gu Por dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bai'ñchu' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Kiudad gu Dabii; gio ba' pai'x xikoolh dɨr gu Millo na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro bhañ gio guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk tu jiim tɨ'ya' na ba' vaak jodai guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu u'vɨ gu Jerusalem mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu ebroon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ma'nkam tu' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu Sammua gu Sobab gu Nataan gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gu Ibar gu Elisua gu Nepeg.
Jano' ba' gu Japia gu Elisama gu Eliada gu Elipelet.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat Xoi'kam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel bɨx gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Dabii; gio ba' na ja'p gu Dabii jix kai suudai' u'va gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Pilisteos jix duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Rapaim.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duu bhaan gu Pilisteos kapbhai' gu noobh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' tu' na gu' gu ñi'ook kapbhai' gu Pilisteos gu noobh.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Dabii gu Baal-perasim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu Baal-perasim.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn duiñxim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Rapaim.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ɨlhdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jaja' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan tu' jix duu yooxi' gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteos dɨr gu Gabaa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Gasa.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' jix búup gu Dabii ka't bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak gu Baal gu Judaa na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix vɨɨk bhɨɨk gu vaak gu Abinadab ka't gu Gabaa; gio ba' gu Ussa gu Aio gu ma'nkam gu Abinadab guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix vɨɨk.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu vaak gu Abinadab ka't gu Gabaa bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aio guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'u ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Nakôn gu Ussa guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' gu vaakax guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ xiixkai.

Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan gu Ussa tu' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi ju'ñdharan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Ussa; gio ba' ka't tɨɨgim mii' dhɨr pai' gu Peeres-ussa bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii; gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Dabii gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo.
Jano' ba' juruuñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom gu Geteo vaik masaa'n; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Obed-edom bɨx gu vaak.

Jano' ba' ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak gu Obed-edom bɨx juraa'n kuiñcha kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu Obed-edom kiicham gu Dabii bɨɨx bhai' ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaakax gu ñi'ook tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ga'ra' tɨi'chu' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx gu vaak gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' na ja'p kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham gu Dabii ka't gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul tu jiim dɨr guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx bɨx gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak zel gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Dabii maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix bhai' aa' gu ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ suudai' u'va; gio ba' ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam maa'n gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak; gio ba' gamai' gu Mikâl guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Dabii jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn nɨidhat tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu duukam na ja'p guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix aa' gu Mikâl; gio ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ xoi'kam gu taat bɨx gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn dhi' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu vupui; gio ba' vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh koi'm.
Jano' ba' ka't kua' tu' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu vaak mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Nataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gɨ' u'u kavɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Nataan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu vupui bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨndak.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel ka't jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' jano' daipu' tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kakneer na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨndak bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tɨɨgɨ' jix gɨ' na ja'p gu tɨɨgɨ' gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn pai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn pai' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ na ja'p va'k.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn maachim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu vaak.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu jiim bɨɨx tattat tu' dhi' gu kai' mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ba'k guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu taat ka't tu' gu mar; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu chichio'ñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu vaak oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ba' bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' atooxkor ka't dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' bɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Nataan gu Dabii.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak na ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bɨɨx ka'm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn dhi' gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gio tu ñi'ook gu vaak tu duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Dabii a'gi'ñchu' bɨndak tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu duukam gu Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam maachim tu duukam.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu' jurtu'nka' bɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ naak bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ maatɨt.

Jano' ba' chɨkka na ja'p gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu Israeel gu oidha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios jum duu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook gu Israeel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa buimɨi gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Ejipto chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios.

Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bhaan tu duukam bhaan gu vaak guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' bɨɨx tas gu vupui jurtu'nka'.

Na ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu vaak tu duukam gu Dabii ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios naak tu duukam bham; gio ba' gu Yo tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaak; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' tu duukam tu' gaagam gu i'ii'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu' dhi' ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't jiimda' tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' mambhɨɨx jano' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak tu duukam na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook bɨɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu vaak tu duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Dabii naaka'n gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii gu Metegamma gu novɨ gu Pilisteos.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Moab guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bɨɨx gook guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ba' koi'm guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu gu Moabitas tu duukam bɨtaa'n namki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam naaka'n gu Dabii gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba jiimchu' jix duu gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Euprates.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kavaayo guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Siros gu Damasko guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ u'ua'tɨdham gu adad-eser gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba; gio ba' gu Dabii naaka'n gu Siros guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Siria gu Damasko jix bɨɨx duu gu Siros tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ namki'ñdha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Dabii kutun kavɨk jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu duukam gu adad-eser guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Beta gu Beerot jɨ'dɨlh gu adad-eser jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Toi gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.

Na gu' bhañ gu Toi gu Joram gu mar gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii tulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ jix bhai' aa' na gu' ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx gu adad-eser ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; na gu' gu Toi ka't bhaamki'ñdha' gu adad-eser; mi' dhɨr gu Joram guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix uam jodai guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Siros gu Moabitas gu Ammonitas gu Pilisteos gu Amalekitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu adad-eser gu mar gu Reob gu gɨ'kora' gu Soba.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Siros naaka'n mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Edom guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu Edom jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' bɨx gu Idumeos jix bɨɨx duu tu duukam gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm pai' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Dabii jix duu bɨx bhai' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Ailud guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Sadok gu mar gu Aitud gu Aimelek gu mar gu Abiatar guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu Seraiia ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada ka't bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chiñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ oi'ñdha' gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Jonataan.

Ba' jix aa' ka't tu duukam gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Siba na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix duu tu' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ soo'mchulhdhak gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu mar gu Jonataan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ duukat gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix bhɨɨ gu vaak gu Makîr gu mar gu Amiel gu Lodebar.

Jano' ba' jix duu tɨbiap gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul gu Dabii o'lhia'n bhaan gu vupui tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam choo'n na gu' tu' tu'r guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨndak xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam gu Jonataan gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sauul gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' jugi bɨɨx tas gu takarui' meesa.
Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' chɨkka tu duukam na ba' tu jiim gagai' jix koi na ja'p tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Siba tu duukam gu Sauul; gio ba' bɨx ka't gu Sauul bɨx gu vaak tu' jix maa gu mar gu Jawatan.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam tu duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu i'bhɨ na ba' gu mar gu Jawatan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu jiim; gio ba' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jawatan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx tas gu takarui' meesa; mi' dhɨr ga'ra' gu Siba guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Siba gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx tu' jix duu gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu duukam; mi' dhɨr gu Mepi-boset jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm meesa na ja'p maa'n gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Mepi-boset gu mar jix ali' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Mikâ; gio ba' bɨx ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Siba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Mepi-boset.

Na gu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Mepi-boset gu Jerusalem na gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx tas meesa gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't jix koi gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu anuun gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bɨɨx gu anuun gu mar gu Naas na ja'p gu taat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Dabii tu duukam bhai'x i'ii'ñ duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat; gu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu duukam gu Dabii gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gui'p gu anuun gu Jawatan; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii gu taat tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ nuukdaidha' cham tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Dabii tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham na ba' cham tu' duu.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu anuun jix bhɨɨ tu duukam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Na gu' na ja'p ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam maachim gu Dabii bhañ jix ai na gu' mi'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jerikoo bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga maaxilhia' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Dabii mɨjɨ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Siros gu vaak gu Reob gu Siros gu Soba guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ tɨɨt; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Maaka mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Is-tob guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ba'k ki'ñgob; gu' gu Siros gu Soba gu Reob gu Is-tob gu Maaka mi'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kapbhai' bɨx guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Israeel jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Siros.
Jano' ba' do'ñcho guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam gu novɨ gu Abisai xibhɨk jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Ammonitas.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu Siros ua'tulhi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ u'ua'tɨdham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jɨ'dɨlh chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Joab gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Siros; gu' jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ñɨi'ñ gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jiboi'ññor gio vupui bhaan gu Abisai baap kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Joab gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem.
Gu' gu' ñɨi'ñ gu Siros guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu adad-eser jix buusñi gu Siros mi'p baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim tɨɨtɨs gu elam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sobak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu adad-eser.

Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii jum daa'ñ bɨx gu Israeel bhɨi gu Jordaan suudai' u'va gu elam; gio ba' gu Siros jix dhaas guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx.

Gu' gu' gu Siros jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' naaka'n gu Dabii gu Siros gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; mi' dhɨr naaka'n gio gu Sobak guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix koi.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu adad-eser na ja'p guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vupui bhaan gu Israeel jix duu bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Siros guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios oidha' tas guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dabii bhañ gu Joab tu duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Ammonitas jix dhaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Rabba; gu' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jerusalem.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kɨkbo gu Dabii guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu tas gu xumai guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak vaak ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' dɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gui'p; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu Bat-seba mar u'vɨ gu Eliam gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Dabii jix duu jix bhɨɨ; gio ba' ka't kia'mi'ñ jix koox bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ bhañ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maachim gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Uriia gu eteo; mi' dhɨr bhañ gu Joab gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Uriia suudai' u'va tɨtda:―¿Jax gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tulhiiñdha' gu Joab guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tulhiiñdha' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tɨɨt; mi' dhɨr gamai' gu Uriia gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va bhaan jugi vaak ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu Uriia jix koox ki'ñgob gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan cham jix dhaav gu vaak.

Jano' ba' jix duu maachim dhi' gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu Uriia cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; jano' ba' cham tɨbiap gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu Uriia jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' tu' gu Israeel gu Judaa bɨtaa'n vaak zel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan gu Joab tu duukam gu Jawatan bhaan gu vupui yooxi'; jano' ba' ka't tu' baakɨi gu vaak na ba' jugi i'i koox bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu Por gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Uriia; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu xibh tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Uriia gu Jerusalem mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh buimgidhak.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' jugi i'i vupui bhaan bɨɨx ka'm tu jiim; gio ba' jix buus gu xumai koox guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan; gu' cham jix dhaav gu vaak.
Jano' ba' namkia' gu xibh ua'na gu Dabii gu Joab gu ñi'ook bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Uriia.

Jano' ba' ua'na gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Uriia vupui bhaan gu kavɨk guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga na ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu Joab guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ kiicham jix dhaas gu Uriia pai' bhai'x mi'p gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gamai' kiicham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Joab ia'rɨ dhɨt gu ja'tkam tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' jix koi gio gu Uriia gu eteo.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab tu' maachim gu Dabii bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix mattuda' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' kua'da' jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kiicham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham bhai'x guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' chɨkka naaka'n gu Abimelek gu mar gu Jerobaal cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu u'vɨ vaak jodai guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi gu Tebes guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vaak jodai; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' daipu'; mi' dhɨr gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu eteo jix koi.
Jano' ba' ka't mattuda' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' mattuda' gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhaan no'ch gu chichio'ñ moor no'ch yooxi' xoi'kam no'ch guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨɨx ka'm ba'k ki'ñgob.
Gu' gu' jix duu bhaan tu duukam dɨr vaak jodai jix koko' dhɨt tu duukam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix koi gio tu duukam gu Uriia gu eteo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii mattuda'; gio ba' daipu' gu Joab; mi' dhɨr cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix duu dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam nɨidhim guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii; jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan kiicham bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix duu tɨiñ gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu chio'ñ gu Uriia ka't jix koi guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhañ gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu vaak; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar; gu' dhi' gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Enbioo gu Jawatan Dios gu Nataan gu Dabii bai'ñpu'; gio ba' ka't gook gu chichio'ñ kiicham maa'n guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gampai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ga'ra' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' gampai' cham ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ali' karneer ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix duu ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx gu ma'nkam bɨɨma'n guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chin guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vaaso kookos guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' ga'ra' na ja'p mar u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va maa'n gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kakneer guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ka't tɨbiap guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix bhɨɨ kaneer mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gampai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't tɨbiap.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ i'iich gu Dabii bhaan mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Nataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim jix duu suuska'n koi'm.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ali' karneer bɨɨx maakobh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' dhi' tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Nataan gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' jix duu mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu Yo tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Sauul.

Jano' ba' tu' gu vaak gu Jawatan gu u'vɨ gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' tu' gu vaak gu Israeel gu Judaa; mi' dhɨr tu' dhi' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu'x.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Uriia gu eteo guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jano' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mɨɨjidha' gu vaak gu kuchii; na gu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu u'vɨ gu Uriia gu eteo na ba' jum duu gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan tu' cham bhai' gu vaak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨtmo guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx gu u'vɨ ñiata dhi' gu tas.
Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ ɨxchuixim; gu' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu tas.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Nataan; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Nataan jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' gio gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ uañi'ñ; gio ba' cham koi.

Na gu' gu' na gu' bɨɨx dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios gu mar tu' maaxir guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Nataan guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu u'vɨ gu Uriia ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tukaa' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' kɨkbo daraa gu vaak jix bɨɨx duu na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha'; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' jix jugi bɨɨx gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh jix koi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gu' tu duukam cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim maachim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't jix koi bham tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix koi.

Gu' gu' gu Dabii ñɨi'ñ tu duukam ñiokda' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't jix koi; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix aa' gu Dabii tu duukam; mi' dhɨr jix koi guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' jix koi.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix búup gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu vaak guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix dhaas gu takarui' jix jugi.

Jano' ba' gui'p tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Por guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix koi guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bham; mi' dhɨr chɨkka guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix duu tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Gu' gu' jano' tu' jix koi na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu Bat-seba gu u'vɨ baakɨk jix koox bɨɨx; gio ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Salomoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Na bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jedidia kuiñcha gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bhaan gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon jix bhɨɨ kiicham vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu Joab jix duu gu Dabii bham; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bhaan gu Rabba guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jano' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn yooxi' bhaan kiicham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' dhaagɨk tu' kiicham cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Dabii bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bhaan gu Rabba guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ kuruun gu gɨ'kora' mo'o guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gɨ' maa'nkar jodai jix uam jodai ga'ra' gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan mo'o gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios kiicham.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ja'tkam ka't jix dhaas bɨtaa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix kavɨk jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix kavɨk jodai; gio ba' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Dabii bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' ua'tulhdhidha' gu Absalom gu mar gu Dabii gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Tamar guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Amnoon gu mar gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Amnoon jix duu bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Tamar gu ja'tkam; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Amnoon guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu jiim guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu Amnoon ga'ra' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu Jonadab gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' gu Amnoon jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Tamar gu ja'tkam gu Absalom xibhɨk.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam ka'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu taat daraibu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu Tamar na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jugi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vupui bhaan tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' ñɨi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Amnoon guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't ka'ook suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' jix duu; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam gu Tamar guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn vupui bhaan tu' gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii bhañ gu Tamar gu vaak bham; gio ba' tu' jano' gu vaak gu Amnoon xibhɨk guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jugi.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Tamar gu vaak xibhɨk gu Amnoon ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ vupui bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix buusñi vupui bhaan; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Amnoon; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat mai' bɨx; gio ba' bɨx moor.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Amnoon gu Tamar; gio ba' jix duu jugi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ba' tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr dhaagɨk gu Tamar guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xibhɨk gu Amnoon guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham xibhɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu kavɨk; na gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' na gu' duukat guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ja'p maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Israeel; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jano' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu'.
Gu' gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' va'k guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Amnoon guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't jix gɨ' xoi'kam bɨɨx ka't dha'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Amnoon; mi' dhɨr bamii' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ' cham bhai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.
Ba' jix aa' va'k guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mai' bhaan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' ga'ra' bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mai' jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ ki'ñgob bhaan.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Tamar jix bhɨɨ maatai guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ bhaan mo'o guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh bhaan mo'o ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa' xibhɨk gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' dhi' bɨndak xibhɨk gu Amnoon guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jano' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ; mi' dhɨr xibhɨk; jano' ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu i'ii'ñ dhi' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Tamar guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak gu Absalom xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii jix kai bɨx dhi' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Absalom cham bɨɨx gu Amnoon tu' cham bhai' tu' jix bhai'; na gu' xoi'kam gu Absalom guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Amnoon na gu' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Absalom ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Bala-asor ju'ñdharan gu Epraim; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Absalom bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Absalom gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam juraa'n jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam bɨɨx tu duukam.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Absalom; na gu' cham gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨx na gu' cham tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' gu' jix bhai' aa'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx no'ch gu Amnoon xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' bɨndak.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Absalom guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' bɨɨx gu Amnoon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Absalom jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bham; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios duuk gu i'ii'ñ gu Amnoon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat suudai' u'va tu ñi'ook tu' gu erid gu Amnoon jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'; na tu' jix duu; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tu jiim jix kavɨk.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Absalom jix duu bɨɨx gu Amnoon na ja'p gu Absalom ka't; gio ba' jix búup bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jiboi'ññor.

Jano' ba' kua' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm chɨtda; gio ba' gu Absalom tu' jix koi bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' kɨkbo gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ jajannulhi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu oidha' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jajannulhi'ñ mi'p vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu mar gu Simea xibhɨk gu Dabii; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix koi bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Amnoon jix koi; na gu' gu chin gu Absalom ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dɨr gu tanoolh gu Amnoon guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Tamar gu ja'tkam.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jano' cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' koko'kam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Amnoon jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix jai' gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu kavɨk.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jonadab gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' jupaabkamu'n; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu ñiokda' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' gio gu gɨ'kora' bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Gu' gu' gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Talmai gu mar gu Amiud gu gɨ'kora' gu Gessur; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Gessur juruuñ vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Absalom; na gu' tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Amnoon ka't jix koi.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' bhañ gu Joab gu Tekoa jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ cham tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam va'k tu' na ja'p gu u'vɨ tu' jix jai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix koi.
Jano' ba' baakɨk gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx dhi'; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Joab gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' dodhia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' tu'r guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu u'vɨ ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam gu chio'ñ jix koi.
