Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan ga'ra' gook gu ma'nkam gook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ yooxi'; gio ba' cham dhaibu guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn naaka'n maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan bham; gio ba' kapbhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xibhɨk na ba' jix duu koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' xibhɨk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gio bi'ya'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ gu Tekoa gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' na cham jir bhai' ka't bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat; gu' gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' cham tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn mia'n gu ɨ'ɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx cham tu' duu gu mar; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o gu mar gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios a'gi'ñchu' gu gɨ'kora' dhi' gu ñi'ook na ja'p guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Na gu' na gu' tɨɨda' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu'ch na ja'p gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' cham jɨ'xdha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix duu; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam cham ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Na gu' tu' tɨbiap jano' na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ɨɨbhi'ñ; gu' ja'tkam na tu juan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook jano' gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Na gu' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'tkam na tu juan gu novɨ gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu mar bɨɨma'n gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan tu ñi'ook; na ka't jano' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix kai jix bhai' cham bhai'; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios cham tu' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu novɨ gu Joab bɨndak guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' tu'x gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu jiim jix duu tu' o'nsop bɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu duukam gu Joab jix aa'ñdhix jix dhaas gu chin ja'tkam na tu juan guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook gu Joab tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' gu Jawatan jix maat jurtu'nka' matda' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix maati' cham tu'x jai'ch gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dhi'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' gu Joab o'lhia'n gu oidha' bhaan gu vupui tu' jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mi' dhɨr jix bhai' aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu duukam gaagam nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; na gu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Joab ka't gu Gessur guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Absalom gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vupui; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Absalom gu vaak cham jix ñi' gu vupui gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' cham ka't bɨx gu Israeel gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim na ja'p gu Absalom guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; gio ba' dɨr gu vaas tɨɨt bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn oidha' tas guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu Nakieeronle gu Absalom vaik gu ma'nkam mar u'vɨ jup tɨɨt gu Tamar ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' juruuñ gu Absalom guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jerusalem cham jix ñi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Absalom guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Joab na ba' tɨip gu gɨ'kora'; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bhañ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gookim tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' tu duukam; gio ba' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Joab ju'ñdharan pai' juraa'n kai' vaas; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tai; jano' ba' tu duukam gu Absalom guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' jix búup guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joab suudai' u'va gu Absalom gu vaak; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu tai tu duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' bham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Gessur tutkɨ mai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu' jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch tu' uañi'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Joab gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios maachim; gio ba' jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Absalom suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu vupui gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' jix duu ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Absalom gu xibh guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob; gio ba' no'x ga'ra' ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Absalom guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga chɨtda; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim kiicham jix duu tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu duukam bopxi'ñ gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom chɨtda; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gu' cham guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Absalom; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jir bɨx bhai' gu oidha' na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' bɨx namki' ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx bhai'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jir bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Absalom gu i'ii'ñ gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam oo'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't gu Absalom gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ebroon guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' tu duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Gessur gu Siria bham; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jerusalem tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix búup ka't gu ebroon.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhañ gu Absalom guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bham; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; mi' dhɨr gu Absalom guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ebroon.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx gu Absalom guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu chichio'ñ gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm koi'cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ cham maachim cham tu'.

Jano' ba' gio bhañ gu Absalom guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Akitopel gu Gilonita guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Dabii gu Gilo kiicham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat suudai' u'va guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Absalom.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu Israeel tu' bhaan gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii bɨx tu duukam mi'p bɨɨx gu Jerusalem; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam vupui bhaan gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix duu cham ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham bhai' bhaan no'ch guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm kiicham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu kuchii.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gui'p gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' jix buus bɨɨx bɨx ja'tkam vaak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu gɨ'kora' bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim pai' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Jano' ba' bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bɨɨx bɨx gu Kereteos gu Peleteos; gio ba' bɨx gu Geteos guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨbiap tɨɨt dɨr gu Gat guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Ittai gu Geteo; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' gio bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu' jix duu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gio pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam pai' na ba' tu' bɨɨx no'ch tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu vupui guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' ka't xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu'r.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Ittai gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' koi'm na ba' gu oidha' pai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Ittai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Ittai gu Geteo bɨx gu chichio'ñ bɨx ja'tkam vaak.

Jano' ba' bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx gu ja'tkam bhi'ñbak gu Kedroon; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt tu' oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gio guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sadok bɨɨx bɨx gu Lebitas guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Abiatar mi' dhɨr ka't gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kiicham bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios kiicham; na tu' bakia' nɨidhidha' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Sadok jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' cham jix duu tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Bueelbete bhai'x i'ii'ñ kiicham; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gook gu ma'nkam gu mar gu Aimaas gu Jonataan gu mar gu Abiatar.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix maa aa'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar suulh kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' gu Dabii jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ joi'ndam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ mo'o iiñat tɨɨt guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; mi' dhɨr gio bɨx gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak jix bhaan dhaas maa'n mo'o guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa joi'ndam na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu jiim bɨɨx gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akitopel.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu usai gu Arakîta jix buus guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' bhaan mo'o.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' jix jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' tu' jix duu kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Absalom; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ tu duukam gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akitopel.

Jano' ba' cham no'm bɨndak gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Por guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx jix duu gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' maa'n aa'ñdham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨɨx gook gu ma'nkam gu Aimaas gu Sadok gu Jonataan gu Abiatar; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ aa'ñdham bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu usai guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dabii kiicham; gio ba' gu Absalom chɨbiapui gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu kavɨk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Siba jix duu gu Mepi-boset busaak guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam buur guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bhaan guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu takarui' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu takarui' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios suudai' u'va.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim dhi' gu Siba jix aa'; mi' dhɨr buur na ba' ja'tkam vaak gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; jano' ba' gu takarui' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; gio ba' suudai' u'va na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ oidha' jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' duukat gu mar gu Jawatan gu Siba jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jerusalem na gu' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu vaak gu Israeel oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu taat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Siba; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨx juraa'n gu Mepi-boset; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Siba guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' nɨidhidha' vupui bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu Baurim; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm busaak maa'n ja'tkam vaak gu vaak gu Sauul guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Semei gu mar gu Gera; mi' dhɨr busaak guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu jodai bhaan gu Dabii bhaan bɨx tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk mi'p kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' chɨtda gu Semei guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ gu Belial.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨx gu ɨ'ɨr gu vaak gu Sauul pai' tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhagia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ gu mar gu Absalom; na gu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na cham jir bhai' na gu' jix duu gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhi' gagai' jix koi gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mo'o.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; na gu' gu Kuee no'ñ tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr chɨkka guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai bɨx tu duukam; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ba'k guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jano' gu mar gu Benjamiin gu Dejadle guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios maa'n gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Dabii guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Semei guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu kavɨk vupui bhaan guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu jodai vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam oo'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel baap gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu Akitopel.

Ba' jix aa' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam na ja'p gu usai gu Arakîta guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Dabii ka't tu jiim gu Absalom gu usai; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom gu usai; gio ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gu usai jix aa' gu Absalom; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr va'k guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' chɨkka ka't tu' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham gu mar na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa vupui bhaan gu taat guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Absalom gu Akitopel; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim chulhiiñchuda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akitopel gu Absalom; gio ba' ba'k guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu taat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' nukadham gu vaak; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu noobh bɨx bɨndak.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaas vaak zel gu Absalom bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chɨbiapui gu Absalom guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu taat gu vupui bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Akitopel mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh ka't na ja'p tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu jiim ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akitopel bɨɨx gu Dabii na ja'p bɨɨx gu Absalom.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Akitopel gu Absalom; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Dabii dhi' gu tukaa'.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu noobh; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx gu ja'tkam tu'; na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ tu' tu jiim bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa xoi'kam gu Absalom bɨx daraa gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Absalom; gio ba' mɨmɨim gio jano' gu usai gu Arakîta na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu usai suudai' u'va gu Absalom bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Akitopel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu usai gu Absalom; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' jix maa dhi' tu jiim gu Akitopel cham jix bhai'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu usai; na pai' dhuuk tu' ñɨidhat gu taat guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ yooxi' na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu taat gu chio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu tukaa' bɨɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jumpa'n pai'; gio ba' tu' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat dhɨt guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Absalom tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk gu i'ii'ñ ka't na ja'p gu i'ii'ñ maavɨt cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu taat gu chio'ñ jix kavɨk bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p oo' jugii'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' tu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ pai' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bakia' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios bhaan na ja'p na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bhaan gu oidha' tu' maa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam kiicham bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ mii' dhɨr kiicham guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu jodai.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Absalom bɨx gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu usai gu Arakîta tutkɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akitopel; na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Akitopel guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa na ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham bhai' bhaan gu Absalom.
Ba' jix aa' gu usai gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Akitopel gu Absalom daraa gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr dhi' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tu'.

Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat aa'ñdham gu Dabii bham; na gu' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi' gu tukaa' vaak ja'tkam oidha' jix gaki guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan na gu' gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx.

Na gu' gu Jonataan gu Aimaas mi'p ju'ñdharan suudai' buusñi gu Rogel na gu' cham guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu jiim bai'ñpu' kiicham; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix maa aa'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Absalom; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gook jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jiim guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu Baurim ga'ra' oidha' suudai' naadat tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu u'vɨ gu vaak guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bhaan gu chin oidha' suudai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan kai'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Absalom gu vaak gu u'vɨ gui'p; gio ba' duukat gu Aimaas gu Jonataan gu u'vɨ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai'; jano' ba' na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ cham gu ñi'ook suulh gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios dhi' moor oidha' suudai' jix bɨɨx duu jix maa aa'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; gio ba' gui'p; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu suudai' na gu' gu Akitopel tu' jix maa tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Dabii jix búup bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan va'k guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ maa'n cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu Akitopel ñɨi'ñ cham ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim buur jix búup ka't gu vaak kiicham; gio ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu vaak guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios jix koi ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tukga'n gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Maanaim gu Absalom guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Amasa bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham pai' gu Joab gu Amasa ka't gu mar gu chio'ñ gu Israeel tɨɨgim gu Itra ka't kia'mi'ñ gu Abigail mar u'vɨ gu Naas gu ja'tkam gu Sarbia gu naan gu Joab.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios yooxi' gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Absalom gu oidha' gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Maanaim gu Sobi gu mar gu Naas gu Rabba gu ma'nkam gu Ammon gu Makîr gu mar gu Ammiel gu Lodebar gu Barsillai gu Galaadita gu Rogelim.

Jano' ba' aichdhak gu Dabii gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx Cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhi'ñ tiriik kai' vaas guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ kai'ñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' suudai' na jix bhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kakneer guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; na gu' gui'p; mi' dhɨr mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu jiim oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu ja'tkam ga'ra' baidhak jix dhaas bhaan bopxi'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia xibhɨk gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Ittai gu Geteo; gio ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr tu' gio guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ bɨɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na gu' tu' no'ch guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga cham jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'ch; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tɨjɨɨ'ñ no'ch guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa cham jix duu guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn no'ch; gu' tu' jano' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p mambhɨɨx mambhɨɨx gɨ' no'ch; mi' dhɨr ka't tutkɨ tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ u'ua'tɨdham dɨr kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' ba'k ki'ñgob guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ busaak bɨx gu ja'tkam chamaam mambhɨɨx gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'ñdhix gu Joab gu Abisai gu Ittai bham; gio ba' gu Tratad guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Absalom; na pai' dhuuk bɨx gu ja'tkam jix kai na pai' dhuuk jix maa gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Absalom bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu ja'tkam yooxi' bhaan gu Israeel jix maa guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Epraim.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ja'tkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan tu duukam gu Dabii tu' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vupui bɨx gu oidha' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Absalom bɨɨx tu duukam gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Absalom bhaan gu ñi'ook chɨbiapui bɨtaa'n tu jiim jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mo'o guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn maa'n guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Joab bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm buupui gu Absalom guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu oidha' bhaan tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ jix maa mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu noobh mambhɨɨx gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai cham guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu' gu novɨ bhaan gu mar gu gɨ'kora'; na pai' dhuuk na gu' no'ch guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' tu' jix aa'ñdhix tu' gu Abisai gu Ittai bham; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Absalom.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm baasɨ'n guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bhaan gu oidha' gu gɨ'kora' cham tu' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tu' dhi' bhaan.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr dhaagɨk vaik guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu noobh guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu i'ii'ñ gu Absalom guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam mambhɨɨx biipibop kutun kavɨk gu Joab jix duu gu Absalom jix bɨɨx duu.

Na gu' jano' ba' gu Joab guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel na gu' gu Joab guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk mi' dhɨr gu Absalom guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix búup bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jix gɨ' gɨ' kavɨk gu jodai; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Absalom gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' cham no'ñ gu mar guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chɨ'ñchoka' gu tɨɨgɨ'; jano' ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' jup tɨɨt pai' gu Absalom bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kuiñcha gu novɨ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh; na gu' cham maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na gu' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Joab gu Kusi; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' buupui; mi' dhɨr gu Kusi jix duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Joab dai'bus.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab; gio ba' ka't ua'tulhi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jano' bhaan gu Kusi; mi' dhɨr gu Joab jix aa'; jano' ba' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ cham bakia' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Gu' gu' jix aa'; gio ba' ka't ua'tulhi'ñ tu' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ; gio ba' dai'bus gu Aimaas guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ vupui bhaan gu Kusi.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam daakat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook kiki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan ki'ñgob vaak jodai guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vupui tu jiim jix ñi' maa'n guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix maa jiiñak tu' maachim gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jix duu; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' jix ñi' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' jix maa jiiñak guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gio mattuda'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ maa'n na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Aimaas gu mar gu Sadok; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu chio'ñ xoi'kam jupaabkamu'n bɨɨx jix bhai' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Aimaas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ ka't gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu' dhagia' gu chichio'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu noobh bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Absalom juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Aimaas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na pai' dhuuk bhañ gu Joab tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu duukam; gu' cham tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Kusi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kuiñcha gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bhaan tu'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' gu Kusi; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Absalom juraa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Kusi jix aa'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p mii' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' bɨx guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bhaan tu' na ba' cham bhai'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm jix tɨ'ɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ ki'ñgob guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' jiimchu' chɨtda; mi' dhɨr gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Absalom gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Absalom gu Kuieen guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios vaak jodai tu' pai' tu' gu Absalom gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jix maa aa'ñdham gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Absalom.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix kai guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu mar.

Jano' ba' chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh kiicham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ baakɨi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ.

Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan dhaas gu vupui tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Absalom gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu mar guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Ba' jix aa' baakɨk gu Joab gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ jix duu gu vupui bɨx tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ pai' gu u'vɨ pai' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam chiñia' tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' gu Absalom guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ xoi'kam no'ch bɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ koko'kam jano' ba' tu' tu jiim.

Jano' ba' bamii' jano' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam mai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu duukam; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Jawatan Dios tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ bɨndak dhi' gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ daam dɨr guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨɨx ka'm jano'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' jix daa ki'ñgob; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn bɨx gu ja'tkam bham; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu gɨ'kora' daakat ki'ñgob; jano' ba' suudai' u'va bɨx gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Israeel ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' dodhia' gu novɨ gu Pilisteos; mi' dhɨr jano' ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu oidha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ɨɨbhi'ñ gu Absalom.

Jano' ba' gu Absalom dua'ñ Xoi'kam bhaan no'ch jix koi guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhañ gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bham; gio ba' gu ablad daraa gu Judaa ja'xñi; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim boopoya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak tu' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel tu' tɨbiap gu gɨ'kora' jix joi'ñ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu ja'tkam; gio ba' o'oo gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim boopoya' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Amasa; gio ba' cham jix duu tu' gio o'o guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chuukug guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' cham tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan tu' na ba' bɨɨx tas pai' gu Joab.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa na ja'p guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu chio'ñ na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' bɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu Judaa suudai' u'va gu Gilgal guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' jix jiim gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' gu Semei gu mar gu Gera gu mar gu Benjamiin ka't gu Baurim jix maa guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx aajidha' mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Siba jix duu gu vaak gu Sauul bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ja'tkam vaak gu gɨ'kora' na ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu Semei gu mar gu Gera o'lhia'n vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jordaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam chɨ'ñchoka' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam jix duu gu tanoolh gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' jix buus gu Jerusalem na ba' nukadham gu gɨ'kora' gu i'ii'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' tu' tu duukam kakasnira' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat uañi'ñ tɨbiap guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ maa'n bɨx gu vaak gu Josee na ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia; gio ba' cham tu' koi guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm dhi' gu Semei guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii jano' ba'; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim namki' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu ma'nkam gu Sarbia guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' koi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ oi'ñdha' gu Israeel cham kakasnira' tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Semei; gio ba' cham koi; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' gio gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Sauul jix dhaav guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' cham ka't tooton tɨɨt tu' ka't guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ka't tooton jajannulhi'ñ dɨr gu tanoolh gu gɨ'kora' jix buus bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh suudai' u'va bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mepi-boset guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu duukam tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; na gu' ka't tu duukam tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam buur guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' jix duu gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' tu duukam guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu vupui xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu vaak gu taat ka't guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn koi'm vupui bhaan gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ koi'cham meesa; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu no'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn na ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhaan gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' gu Siba guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' gu Mepi-boset gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gio gu Barsillai gu Galaadita jix dhaav gu Rogelim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na ba' tu jiim baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Barsillai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ka't jix maa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Maanaim na gu' ka't gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Barsillai; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jugi guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Barsillai gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu oidha' na ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tanoolh guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' cham bhai'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam jano' tu duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu duukam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu duukam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu Jordaan bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix gɨ' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Jano' ba' tu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu duukam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa kiicham ju'ñdharan tukga'n gu taat gu naan; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu duukam gu Kimam; na guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Kimam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx na ja'p xoi'kam tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu' jix duu tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' ka't gio guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Barsillai jix bhai' aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu vaak.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Gilgal bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Kimam; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Judaa bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs gu gɨ'kora' gui'p; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu chichio'ñ gu Judaa guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ja'tkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ baabuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Jordaan gu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaak bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Dabii bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ gu Judaa tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel; na gu' gu gɨ'kora' chulhiiñdha' jir bɨx bhai'; gu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ no'ch guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dho'ñchidhak guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gui'p gu Judaa; gio ba' no'ch tañia' gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham a'aixkam no'ch maa'n guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chio'ñ gu Judaa ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk gu chio'ñ gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Akaekioo guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri gu chio'ñ gu Benjamiin guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' cham tañia' no'ch baasɨ'n gu Dabii tu' gu maa'nkar gu mar gu Isaii; mi' dhɨr gu Israeel maa'n dhi'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel oi'ñchu' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri; gu' gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gu Jordaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Dabii gu vaak gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' mambhɨɨx gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn ka't tɨtda:―Cha'pim na ba' nukadham gu vaak jix dhaas gu vaak jix nukadham jix maa jugi; gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ chɨbiapui guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix koko' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Amasa; gio ba' gu Juuntame gu chio'ñ gu Judaa na ba' tu jiim vaik gu tanoolh guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Amasa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Judaa; gu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios ka't guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ nɨi'ñchudat.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Abisai; gio ba' gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jano' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ cham bhai' gu Absalom; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tu' tu duukam gu Jawatan tu' bhaan cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' moor guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu chichio'ñ gu Joab gu Kereteos gu Peleteos bɨx jix kavɨk; gio ba' moor gu Jerusalem na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.

Jano' ba' kua' mia'n jix gɨ' jodai kavɨk gu Gabaoon jix buus gu Amasa guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; gio ba' jano' xoi'kam kutun gu Joab ga'ra' daam guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joab gu Amasa; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa bhai'x i'ii'ñ xibhɨk guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam jix bhɨɨ gu Joab bɨɨx kɨɨ'n guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Amasa na ba' jix duu.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Amasa cham guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Joab gu novɨ ga'ra' naaka'n guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn ja'aa ba'k guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn jix koi cham jix duu gook guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' mi' dhɨr gu Joab xibhɨk gu Abisai jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.

Jano' ba' maa'n guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Joab tu jiim ju'ñdharan bham; gio ba' no'x guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Joab gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Joab.

Jano' ba' gu Amasa ka't guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt; na gu' ñɨi'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam tu jiim jix ai'chdhix gu Amasa gu bhóogɨt yooxi' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan kutun na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨx aajidha' tu jiim ju'ñdharan.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu bhóogɨt guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨx oi'ñchu' gu Joab na ba' tu' bhaan gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel gu Bet-maakâ bɨx gu Barim; gio ba' jum daa'ñ bhiadat gio.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu Abel gu Bet-maakâ jix dhaas guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bhaan kiicham; gio ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam ka't vaak jodai bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't bɨɨx gu Joab guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix maa jiiñak kiicham bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu Joab guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ba' tu' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duu tu' gu Joab jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu ñi'ook ja'tkam na tu juan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios ñiokda' bham; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tas ñiokda' bham; na tu ñi'ook gu Abel; jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn cham tu' duu kiicham gu naan gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' bham; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim cham pai' dhuuk tu jiim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn cham; gu' gu chio'ñ gu kavɨk gu Epraim mɨmɨim gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii; mi' dhɨr kapbhai' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jix duu kiicham; jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix aa' gu Joab; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mo'o tu' ka't guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam dɨr vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ ka't bɨx gu ja'tkam bɨɨx matda'; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ mo'o gu Seba gu mar gu Bikri guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu Joab; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kiicham maa'n dhi'; jano' ba' gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Joab bhaan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada bhaan gu Kereteos gu Peleteos.
Jano' ba' gu Adoram bhaan bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu Josapat gu mar gu Aillud guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' gu Seba guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ira gu Jaireo ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' gu Seba guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' gu Sadok gu Abiatar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Ira gu Jaireo ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gɨ'kora' ja'tkam mia'n gu Dabii.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Dabii ka't bhiogi' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mii' dhɨr gu vaak gu ɨ'ɨr; na gu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Gabaonitas.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jup tɨɨt gu Gabaonitas; gio ba' gu Gabaonitas cham guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Amorreos gu ma'nkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gu' gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios kooda' bɨɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Judaa; jano' ba'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Gabaonitas; gio ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios na ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Gabaonitas tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tañia' no'ch guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan jix toja jodai tu' bhaan jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu Sauul bɨɨx gu vaak; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu chio'ñ gu Israeel; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim bhaan no'ch na ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn cham tu' no'ch bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn kɨɨv gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam na ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Gabaa gu Sauul guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Mepi-boset gu mar gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dabii gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sauul.

Gu' gu' jix bhɨɨ gu gɨ'kora' gook gu ma'nkam gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Sauul maachim gu Armoni gu Mepi-boset; gio ba' jixchamaam gu ma'nkam gu Mikâl mar u'vɨ gu Sauul ka't guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Adriel gu mar gu Barsillai gu Molatita.

Jano' ba' do'ñcho gu noobh gu Gabaonitas guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu kavɨk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix koko' tɨtda:―Aañ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam kɨɨv jix bɨɨx duu koko'kam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oraa' dharka' gu tanoolh gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' kai' vaas.

Jano' ba' dhaagɨk gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam bhaan guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ dɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam oraa' bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn bhaan gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn matgɨm gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr tu jiim bhaan gu tanoolh tu' gu vaakax yooxi' gu tukaa'.
Jano' ba' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Rispa mar u'vɨ gu Aja guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Sauul.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' gu Dabii ka't jix bhɨɨ o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar gu chichio'ñ gu Jabes gu Galaad guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ ɨrban gu Bet-san pai' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Pilisteos na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Pilisteos gu Sauul gu Gilboa.
Jano' ba' jix duu guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ o'oo gu Sauul o'oo gu Jonataan gu mar; gio ba' jum daa'ñ gio o'oo guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios o'oo gu Sauul gu mar gu Jonataan gu oidha' gu Benjamiin gu Sela tukga'n gu Kis gu taat; gio ba' tu' jix duu bɨx gu gɨ'kora' ka't; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel jix dhaav gu Dabii tu duukam bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu Isbi-benob ka't gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ u'u kavɨk ka't vaik guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ga'ra' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu kuchii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios jix duu gu Dabii.

Gu' gu' gu Abisai gu mar gu Sarbia guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteo guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; gio ba' jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Dabii guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios bham; na gu' cham pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga bɨɨx no'ch guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ na gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gookim bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't mi' dhɨr gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Sibekâi gu usatita naaka'n gu Sap ka't gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't gu Gob bhaan gu Pilisteos gu Elanan gu mar gu Jaare-oregim gu Bet-leem naaka'n gu Goliat gu Geteo guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'u kavɨk ka't na ja'p guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Gat pai' ka't gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' tu jiim ga'ra' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu noobh guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨɨt maakob bɨx; gio ba' gio ka't gu ma'nkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' dhi' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu Jonataan gu mar gu Sima xibhɨk gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam maakobh guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat maaxir guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Gat ia'rɨ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ gu Dabii guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu novɨ tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook dhi' bhai' ñi'ook gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bɨx guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ gu Sauul.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk gu kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gio ba' kutun kavɨk guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga tulhiiñdha' gu kavɨk guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ; mi' dhɨr boosolh guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Jawatan Dios suuska'n guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ koi'm guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' na cham jir bhai' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn koi'm.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix kai gu ñi'ook dɨr vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tu ñi'ook maatɨt.

Jano' ba' gu oidha' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; na gu' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu tɨkɨr jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na gu' tu jiim.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ kuubh guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu chin gu tai guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu tɨkɨr jix dhaav; gio ba' gu tukgam bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ bhaan juu'ñdham tɨkɨr da'a; gio ba' jix ñi'ñ bhaan guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu jɨvɨl.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu tukgam xikoolh ba'r; gio ba' gu suudai' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam tɨbaa'ñ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu Altiisimo jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu gɨ' suudai' guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga oipichu' jix bɨɨx duu guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu i'ii'ñ daak.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mii' dhɨr ja'tkam guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ jix kavɨk tu'.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios gu tanoolh guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ; na gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat na gu' jix dhaas aagak tu'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu noobh jix maa guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' vupui bhaan tu' no'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios; gio ba' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu jiim cham guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tu jiim bɨx bhai' na ba' bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu jiim guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai' jurtu'nka' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix bhai' jix duu guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat bɨɨx bɨx bhai' tu' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' jix duu na ba' bɨɨx gu' bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga; gu' gu vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duu guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu tasi' gu tukgam.
Na gu' na gu' tu' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios chugi'ñ bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam kutun kavɨk bɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa.
Na gu' na gu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'x jai'ch guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix kavɨk guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu bhóogɨt.
Na guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tɨɨt na ja'p guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Na guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu noobh na ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ jix maa bɨɨx guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios u'u gat guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam kutun kavɨk tulhiiñdha' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ bɨtaa'n tu' na ba' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨkbok.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam bɨtaa'n tɨɨt.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu kavɨk na ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios bɨtaa'n tu' bhaan tu' jix búup.
Jano' ba' tu' chɨɨdak guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tu' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios.
Jano' ba' tu jiim cham ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu' cham jix aa'.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam na ja'p oo' gu oidha'; gio ba' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ na ja'p guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam.

Jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam na ba' jum duu mo'o chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam cham guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ tu'; gio ba' tɨiñ guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat jodai kavɨk; gio ba' ka't guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Jawatan Dios jodai kavɨk dodhia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu ja'tkam bɨtaa'n tu'.

Jano' ba' jix buusñi tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios; gio ba' tu' jix buusñi guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix búup bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu chio'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Na ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Na guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn tulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch Xoi'kam gu Dabii gu kai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' dhi' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu Dabii; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu mar gu Isaii mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ Xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu Jakob jix duu guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tu' gu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ nɨɨn.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' tu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu Israeel; gio ba' aapi' gu chichio'ñ ka't jir bhai' aapi' choo'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk ka't na ja'p gu tasi' gu xibh na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu tas gu xibh cham tɨbaa'ñ; na pai' dhuuk gu vaas gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios mi' dhɨr dhuuk.

Jano' ba' cham gu vaak na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ tu'x ka't guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam bɨx dhi' tulhiiñdha' bɨx gu ñi'ook cham guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Gu' gu' gu Belial ka't bɨx na ja'p jo'ii' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam soo'mchulhdhak guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam bɨɨx gu novɨ.
Gu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ kuichdha' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam jix kavɨk jodai guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat u'u kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn pai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Dabii; gio ba' gu Takmonita guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa; mi' dhɨr ka't guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Adino gu Esnita guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bua' bhaan guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu chichio'ñ.

Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Eleasar gu mar gu Dodo gu Aoi ka't vaik jix kavɨk mi'p bɨɨx gu Dabii na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' dhi' kɨkbo naaka'n gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu novɨ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga gu kuchii; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam ka't gu Samma gu mar gu Age gu Araita; na guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ ka't guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam ka't guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam vupui bhaan gu Pilisteos.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' tu jiim tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam gu oidha' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn tu' naaka'n gu Pilisteos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu tulhiiñdha'.

Jano' ba' vaik guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu ñi'ook guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam tɨɨtɨs guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios oraa' gu Dabii jumpa'n gu Adullam; gio ba' yooxi' gu Pilisteos ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Rapaim.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios gu Pilisteos ka't gu Bet-leem.
Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios i'i gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Bet-leem ki'ñgob.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' vaik jix kavɨk guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm yooxi' gu Pilisteos guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu suudai' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Bet-leem ka't ki'ñgob; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam aichdhak gu Dabii; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'i guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat ja'aa gu Jawatan Dios bham.

Jano' ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ ka't tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn dhi'; gio ba' i'i tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu oidha' cham guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ i'i; mi' dhɨr vaik jix kavɨk jix duu dhi'.

Jano' ba' gu Abisai xibhɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia ka't gɨ'kora' ja'tkam vaik; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios u'u kavɨk bhaan vaik guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik.
Jano' ba' ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook vaik maa'n; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik dharka'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada gu mar gu chio'ñ guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Kabseel; gio ba' dhi' naaka'n gook guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu Moab; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav tu' naaka'n maavɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios jabook.

Jano' ba' gio naaka'n gu Egipkio gu chio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; gio ba' ga'ra' gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ; gu' jix dhaav bɨɨx guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu Egipkio u'u kavɨk gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ bɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn u'u kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Benaiia gu mar gu Joiada guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim gu tɨɨgɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu ñi'ook; gu' cham guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam vaik dharka'; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu Dabii guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ.
Jano' ba' gu Asael xibhɨk gu Joab ka't guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gu Elaanan gu mar gu Dodo gu Bet-leem.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu arodi gu Elika gu arodi.
Jano' ba' gu eles gu Palti gu ira gu mar gu Jekkes gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Abieser gu Anatot gu Mebunnai gu usa.
Jano' ba' guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ao gu Maarai gu Netopat.
Jano' ba' gu elek gu mar gu Baana gu Netopat gu Ittai gu mar gu Ribai gu Gabaa gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Benaiia gu Piratonita gu iddai guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn gu Gaas.
Jano' ba' gu Abi-albon gu Arbat gu Asmabet gu Barum.
