Jano' ba' gu Eliaba gu Saalboon gu Jonataan gu ma'nkam gu Jasseen.
Jano' ba' gu Samma gu Arar gu Aiam gu mar gu Sarar gu Arar.
Jano' ba' gu Elipelet gu mar gu Asbai gu mar gu Maakâti; gio ba' gu Eliam gu mar gu Akîtopel gu Geloon.
Jano' ba' gu esrai gu Karmelo gu Parai gu Arbi.
Jano' ba' gu Igeal gu mar gu Nataan gu Soba gu Bani gu Gadi.
Jano' ba' gu Selek gu Ammoon gu Naarai gu Beerot kutun kavɨk gu Joab gu mar gu Sarbia.
Jano' ba' gu Ira gu Itri gu Gareb gu Itri.
Jano' ba' gu Uriia gu eteo; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Bolbioo i'iich gu Jawatan Dios jix duu bhaan gu Israeel tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii bhaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Israeel gu Judaa.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' baidhak; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ bopxi'ñ gu Israeel dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu ja'tkam na ba' tu' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim mui'kim guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam na ja'p guiꞌ na mɨk kat chɨt jir tasiꞌ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'; gu' na ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ dhi' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora'.

Gu' cham guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' guiꞌ na jix bɨɨx jum duukam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ gu Joab guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buus gu Joab bɨɨx guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' na ba' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bhɨi gu Jordaan guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu Aroer gu novɨ jix duu kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat gu Gad ju'ñdharan gu Jaser.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu Galaad gu oidha' guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam gu Absi; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Dan-jaaan xikoolh gu Sidoon.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu Tiro guiꞌ na jix bhaꞌm ji chɨꞌñ jɨ'dɨlh gu ebeos gu Kananeos; gio ba' moor saagi'ñ gu Judaa gu Beer-seba.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr a'lhiok guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨx gu oidha' suulh gu Jerusalem guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga masaa'n guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu Joab jix maa guiꞌ na jir xoiꞌkam jaꞌtkam jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Israeel guiꞌ na jix chuꞌm tu aꞌga mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu kuchii; mi' dhɨr gu Judaa guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam guiꞌ na jix chakuiꞌ jodaiꞌ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu Yo uañi'ñ guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam dhi'; na gu' gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios uañi'ñ tu duukam na gu' tu' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm.

Na pai' dhuuk guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii ka't guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Gad jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn gu Dabii bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Dabii; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr vaik tu'x tu' guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; jano' ba' tu' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam tu' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn.

Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Gad gu Dabii tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat; gio ba' tu jiim tu' guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ kɨɨv guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bhiogi' gu oidha' guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam vaik masaa'n vupui bhaan guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn vaik gu tanoolh ka't guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu oidha' gu Piensa jano' guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim tu ñi'ook tu' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Dabii gu Gad; gio ba' jix gɨ' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ dhi'; na gu' soi'ñ guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios na gu' tu jiim mumua'da' cham guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ tu' gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Israeel dɨr gu xibh bɨɨx ka'm guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios nɨi'ñchudat; gio ba' jix koko' gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Dan bɨɨx ka'm gu Beer-seba guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p nobii'ñ guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu novɨ bhaan gu Jerusalem na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam mii' dhɨr cham bhai' nobii'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam jano'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na cham paiꞌ dho jugiaꞌ gu novɨ; jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't ju'ñdharan ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.

Ba' jix aa' gu Dabii gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk jix ñi' nobii'ñ guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Yo guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios tu' guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat tu' na cham jir bhai'; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jix duu dhi' kakneer gu Rueegote gu novɨ guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ bhaan tu' bhaan gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Gad suudai' u'va gu Dabii mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh; gio ba' tu jiim gu vupui jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Arauna gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Dabii jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Gad gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duu.
Jano' ba' tɨɨgɨk gu Arauna jix ñi' gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam guiꞌ na uxkam tu ibaiꞌ; gio ba' gamai' jano' ba' gu Arauna guiꞌ na tu maakiaꞌ gu Dios vupui bhaan gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu oidha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna; gio ba' guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim jupaabkamu'n gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' tu duukam gu Dabii jix aa'; na ba' guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn tu' ka't na ba' guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na paiꞌ dho jaꞌk oiꞌñgaꞌn guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn guiꞌ na mɨk tu daꞌa gu ja'tkam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu Dabii; gio ba' guiꞌ na jir ñiꞌookiꞌñ gu Dios guiꞌ na jix kɨɨꞌ tu jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌx iꞌiiꞌñ; mi' dhɨr guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm gu vaakax na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan; jano' ba' guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim guiꞌ na jir baakiꞌñ gu Dios gu vaakax na ba' gu u'u.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix maa na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Arauna gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' ka't guiꞌ na suudaiꞌ chɨt tu jiim.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Arauna; gio ba' cham guiꞌ na bɨx oiꞌñgaꞌn jix maat guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm u'uuk tu' guiꞌ na jir gɇꞌkam taataꞌn; na gu' cham guiꞌ na ja jɨɨꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm cham tu'; jano' ba' gu Dabii guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn ka't gu vaakax guiꞌ na oiꞌñgaꞌn tu soiꞌm mambhɨɨx guiꞌ na miꞌ dhɨr jir maraaꞌn jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Dabii jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan guiꞌ na miꞌ pɨx tu jaꞌk tu uꞌuam; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios guiꞌ na jix bhaiꞌ tu duñiaꞌ bɨɨx gu oidha' jix utu'ñ guiꞌ na jix uañiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam gu Israeel.
